**Executive Briefing Proposal: Tamarack Instruments**

Dear Dana Whitfield,

**Situation Summary**

Tamarack Instruments designs and manufactures laboratory measurement instruments and operates in the Netherlands, Germany and the United States. The Client's AI use cases are a customer service chatbot deployed on the support portal, an AI visual inspection pilot on the German production line and AI sales forecasting planned for next year. AI maturity is recorded as Piloting. Your stated objective is: "I want governance in place before visual inspection goes into production in Q2 2027." The regulatory drivers are the EU AI Act and GDPR. ISO/IEC 42001 work is expected to start next year, though the start date is not fixed. The stated constraints are a budget approved up to US$80,000 this fiscal year, a requirement that customer data stay in the EU and consultation with the German works council before anything touches production staff.

**What the Briefing Covers for the Client**

The Briefing will map the EU AI Act and GDPR to each of the three use cases. This includes how the chatbot and the visual inspection pilot may be classified and what transparency and AI literacy expectations may apply. These are framed as expectations to verify with counsel, not legal advice. United States requirements are not among the stated drivers, so they will appear only as a general landscape item. The readiness discussion will be anchored to the Q2 2027 objective, the EU data constraint and the works council constraint.

We will outline a governance operating model using two frameworks: the GRC Workbook (https://github.com/rolldabones/grc-workbook) and Slow AI Kitchen (https://github.com/rolldabones/slow-ai-kitchen). Board-layer considerations will draw on AI Governance for Boards (https://github.com/rolldabones/ai-governance-for-boards). The session is guided by the principles Slow AI, Informed Intent, Final Liability rests with the Human. We will show how this foundation can support the planned ISO/IEC 42001 work. We do not promise certification, audit outcomes or regulatory approval.

**Logistics and Price**

The Executive Briefing is a two-hour live virtual session for executive leadership and board-level attendees. The audience roles listed are General Counsel, CISO, Head of Quality, Head of Data, German plant manager and two internal auditors. The price is US$3,000.

**What the Client Receives Afterward**

The Client will receive a follow-up summary memo. It will record the decisions surfaced, readiness observations and three prioritized recommendations. Each recommendation will be mapped to a next program option with a proposed timeline.

**Next Step**

The decision timeline is not yet known. At intake we would like to confirm four points:

1. Which named individuals will attend.
2. Whether any incumbent frameworks or prior risk events should inform the session.
3. The current status of the visual inspection pilot.
4. Whether any instruments fall under EU product legislation relevant to the EU AI Act.

Once these points are confirmed, we will propose a session date.

Kind regards,

AI Governance Academy

Human-made, for Easy Work, Simply Done.
